# octopusdeploy_runbooks (Data Source)

Provides information about existing Octopus Deploy runbooks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# every runbook in the space
data "octopusdeploy_runbooks" "all" {}

# every runbook belonging to one project
data "octopusdeploy_runbooks" "project" {
  project_id = "Projects-123"
}

# runbooks whose name contains "Restart", within one project
data "octopusdeploy_runbooks" "restart" {
  project_id   = "Projects-123"
  partial_name = "Restart"
}

# specific runbooks by ID
data "octopusdeploy_runbooks" "by_id" {
  ids = ["Runbooks-1", "Runbooks-2"]
}

output "runbook_names" {
  value = [for runbook in data.octopusdeploy_runbooks.project.runbooks : runbook.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ids` (List of String) A filter to search by a list of IDs.
- `partial_name` (String) A filter to search by a partial name.
- `project_id` (String) A project ID to filter by. When set, only runbooks belonging to that project are returned.
- `skip` (Number) A filter to specify the number of items to skip in the response.
- `space_id` (String) A Space ID to filter by. Will revert what is specified on the provider if not set.
- `take` (Number) A filter to specify the number of items to take (or return) in the response.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID for this resource.
- `runbooks` (Attributes List) A list of runbooks that match the filter(s). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runbooks))

<a id="nestedatt--runbooks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runbooks`

Read-Only:

- `connectivity_policy` (Attributes List) The connectivity policy of the runbook. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runbooks--connectivity_policy))
- `default_guided_failure_mode` (String) The runbook guided failure mode.
- `description` (String) The description of the runbook.
- `environment_scope` (String) Determines how the runbook is scoped to environments.
- `environments` (List of String) When environment_scope is "Specified", the environments the runbook can be run against.
- `force_package_download` (Boolean) Whether packages are re-downloaded.
- `id` (String)
- `multi_tenancy_mode` (String) The tenanted deployment mode of the runbook.
- `name` (String) The name of the runbook.
- `project_id` (String) The project that this runbook belongs to.
- `published_runbook_snapshot_id` (String) The published snapshot ID.
- `retention_policy` (Attributes List) The runbook retention policy, in the form kept for backwards compatibility. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runbooks--retention_policy))
- `retention_policy_with_strategy` (Attributes List) The runbook retention policy, including its strategy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runbooks--retention_policy_with_strategy))
- `runbook_process_id` (String) The runbook process ID.
- `runbook_tags` (Set of String) The tags associated with this runbook.
- `space_id` (String) The space that this runbook belongs to.

<a id="nestedatt--runbooks--connectivity_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runbooks.connectivity_policy`

Read-Only:

- `allow_deployments_to_no_targets` (Boolean)
- `exclude_unhealthy_targets` (Boolean)
- `skip_machine_behavior` (String)
- `target_roles` (List of String)


<a id="nestedatt--runbooks--retention_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runbooks.retention_policy`

Read-Only:

- `quantity_to_keep` (Number) How many runs to keep per environment.
- `should_keep_forever` (Boolean) Whether runs are never deleted.


<a id="nestedatt--runbooks--retention_policy_with_strategy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runbooks.retention_policy_with_strategy`

Read-Only:

- `quantity_to_keep` (Number) The number of runs or days of runs kept, depending on the unit.
- `strategy` (String) How retention is set. One of `Default`, `Forever` or `Count`.
- `unit` (String) The unit of the quantity kept, either `Items` or `Days`.
